paragraphs.text:
Norman disappears into the woods. The bird is after you. In the 
swampy ground you can’t achieve full speed, but neither can it.

Make a Hard CON roll: if you succeed, the bird loses interest, go 
to 365; if not, it catches up, and that is the end of the Nadelmann 
Expedition. THE END.
